strings.59-ФЗ, статья 12, часть 1: рассмотрение: Federal Law No. 59-FZ, Article 12, part 1: reviewing a submission within the scope of competence.
strings.Авторское учебное изложение закона: Author's training summary of the law
strings.Адрес, описание неисправности и просьба: The address, a description of the fault and a request to arrange consideration of the issue.
strings.В варианте с неопределимой сутью дополни: The variant with an unidentifiable subject has no extra materials. Here the accepted attachment changes the conclusion: the issue is identifiable and requires substantive consideration.
strings.В данном упражнении счёт начинается со с: In this exercise, counting starts on the day after registration; a deadline falling on a non-working day moves to the next working day. This is a separate task about the deadline for the specified action, not about fully resolving the real-life problem.
strings.Выясните, что именно произошло и что под: Establish exactly what happened and what the materials confirm.
strings.Граждане и все материалы инцидента вымыш: The citizens and all incident materials are fictional. Any conditions of a particular service given here are a training model, not a quotation from real regulations. Act within your role. The calendar task concerns only the action it specifies.
strings.Да, в условии подтверждены полномочия; н: Yes, the scenario confirms our authority; no referral is needed.
strings.Да, на первом листе; они читаемы и соотв: Yes, on the first page; they are legible and match the inventory.
strings.Да, оно поступило вместе с письмом и учт: Yes, it arrived with the letter and is listed in the inventory.
strings.Каждый лист должен отдельно содержать по: Every page must independently contain a complete appeal, otherwise the whole package is rejected.
strings.Какая часть комплекта раскрывает вопрос?: Which part of the package reveals the issue?
Which part of the package reveals the issue? Link the extracted information to the decision based on the materials.
strings.Какой вывод подтверждается сопоставление: Which conclusion is supported by comparing the materials?
strings.Крайний день рассмотрения обращения: Last day for reviewing the submission
strings.На первом листе письма одна фраза: «Прош: The first page contains one sentence: “Please investigate; everything is in the attachment.” An employee thinks the subject is unclear. The duty officer shows the attached document with a specific address, event and request.
strings.Найдите применимое положение, проверьте: Find the applicable provision, check its connection to the materials and justify the action. Training material is not a normative legal act.
strings.Найдите статью о порядке рассмотрения от: Find the article on handling specific types of appeals and match the relevant part to the case circumstances.
strings.Не заменяет специальную норму: Does not replace a special provision
strings.Нужно оценить поступивший материал в цел: Assess the received materials as a whole; an attachment accepted with the appeal may make its subject identifiable.
strings.Оба листа приняты и зарегистрированы сов: Both pages were accepted and registered together on {{registered}}. The attachment is not a later addition. The materials provide no basis for declaring the original appeal devoid of a subject from the first page alone.
strings.Обращение рассматривается в пределах ком: An appeal is considered within jurisdiction; any special procedure requires a separate check. General written-reply periods are not the same as deadlines for repairs, benefits or register corrections.
strings.Общий маршрут определён конкретной компе: The general route is determined by specific competence.
strings.Остальные листы не влияют на предмет обр: The other pages do not affect the appeal’s subject.
strings.Ответ находится в приложении · проверка: The answer is in the attachment · checking the basis
strings.Относится ли предмет к нашему органу?: Does the matter fall within our authority?
strings.Отправить уведомление о неопределимости: Send a notice that the subject is unidentifiable without reading the received attachment.
strings.Отправлено {{sent}}, поступило {{receive: Sent on {{sent}}, received on {{received}}, registered on {{registered}}. The latest event in the materials is dated {{observed}}. Do not confuse the complaint deadline with the service deadline or the time needed to resolve the problem.
strings.Первый фрагмент пересказывает условие за: The first passage restates the task conditions, not real regulations or a website extract. The external link verifies the legal basis, not the incident's facts.
strings.Перед вами письменный материал, а не лич: You are dealing with written material, not an in-person meeting with its author. The duty officer reports only what is established from the envelope, text and annexes. Do not reconstruct unknown circumstances by guesswork.
strings.Подготовить надлежащее рассмотрение опре: Prepare proper consideration of the identifiable issue
strings.Подписать ответ, поскольку хотя бы какое: Sign the response because at least some attachment was considered.
strings.Помощник: «Чтобы определить суть, достат: Assistant: “Reading the heading is enough to identify the subject.”
strings.Попросить гражданина ещё раз доказать, ч: Ask the citizen to prove again that they sent the page at all.
strings.Последующий результат проверен по сущест: The subsequent result has been checked against the substance of the case.
strings.Предмет обращения определяется по компле: The package identifies the appeal’s subject.
strings.Предмет определяется по поступившему ком: The subject is determined from the received package, including the legible attachment; a brief first page does not mean the subject is absent.
strings.Прекращение работы без выяснения обстоят: Stopping work without clarifying the circumstances
strings.Признать отсутствие сути, игнорируя прин: Declare the subject absent while ignoring the substantive document accepted
strings.Приложение поступило одновременно и раск: The attachment arrived at the same time and explains a specific issue. It is part of the training package and establishes the substance. The conditions for Article 11, part 4.1 are not met here, even if the first page alone is brief.
strings.Приложения разрешено изучать только посл: Attachments may be examined only after sending a notice that the subject is missing.
strings.Проверить первый лист, опись и наличие п: Check the first page, inventory and presence of the attachment
strings.Проверить, что исполнитель получил именн: Check that the case officer received the correct attachment and answered its actual subject
strings.Профиль исчисления этого упражнения: исх: This exercise's calculation profile excludes the starting day and rolls the deadline forward, using the federal five-day working week. It is not a rule for every procedure.
strings.Процедура предоставления услуги вместо о: A service-delivery procedure instead of reviewing a submission
strings.Рассматривать определимое обращение по в: Consider the identifiable appeal using the whole package rather than sending a notice because its first page is brief.

Review the identifiable appeal using the complete package, rather than sending a notice because the first page is brief. In the variant with an unidentifiable substance, there are no additional materials. Here, the accepted attachment changes the conclusion: the issue can be identified and must be considered on its merits.
strings.Рассмотрение обращения по закону № 59-ФЗ: Review of a submission under Law No. 59-FZ
strings.Рассмотреть определимый вопрос в предела: Consider the identifiable issue within our remit, taking both the first page and accepted attachment into account.
strings.Реквизиты и содержание распределены межд: The details and content are distributed across the pages.
strings.Сведения о другом заявителе, объекте или: Information about another applicant, facility or period does not replace verification in this case. A body's name does not grant an employee unlimited powers.
strings.Сначала определите действие, для которог: First identify the action to which the deadline applies. Applying for a service, registering a complaint and resolving a problem are not the same event.
strings.Содержание нельзя оценивать только по пе: The contents cannot be assessed from the first page alone.
strings.Сопоставить опись и входящий номер, пере: Match the inventory and incoming reference number, provide the correct attachment and check that the response addresses the actual issue.
strings.Сопоставить читаемое содержание приложен: Match the legible attachment contents with the applicant’s details
strings.Сопоставьте вывод с документами и провер: Compare the conclusion with the documents and check the limits of authority.
strings.Существенное обстоятельство продолжения: A material circumstance in the continuation was left unchecked.
strings.Только обстоятельства данной вымышленной: Only the circumstances of this fictional situation
strings.Требовать новую подачу только из-за расп: Require resubmission solely because the information is split across two pages
strings.Требовать от автора переписать оба листа: Make consideration conditional on the author rewriting both pages as one document.
strings.Уведомить заявителя о дальнейших действи: Notify the applicant of next steps without imposing an unsupported requirement to rewrite the appeal
strings.Учебное продолжение. В проекте ответа оп: Training follow-up. The draft response describes a different location: the case officer was mistakenly given an attachment belonging to the neighbouring incoming reference number.
strings.Учебный комплект: на первом листе фамили: Training package: the first page gives the surname, postal address and a reference to the attachment. The listed attachment is legible and describes a specific event, object address and request. Together the materials identify the appeal’s subject, which falls within the current authority’s remit.
strings.Учебный материал; ссылка ведёт к правово: Training material; the link leads to the legal basis
strings.Фамилия и адрес заявителя известны?: Are the applicant’s surname and address known?
